name: idle
label: 待机
description: 默认待机：随机头部摆动 + 呼吸
formula: return { bones: { head: [Math.sin(t*0.7)*0.08 - 0.02, Math.sin(t*0.4)*0.18, Math.sin(t*0.3)*0.06], chest: [Math.sin(t*0.9)*0.05, Math.sin(t*0.25)*0.08, 0], spine: [0, 0, Math.sin(t*0.4)*0.04], hips: [0, 0, Math.sin(t*0.3)*0.03] }, scenePosY: Math.abs(Math.sin(t*0.9))*0.02, scenePosX: Math.sin(t*0.4)*0.01 };

name: wave
label: 挥手
description: 举手挥舞, 打招呼或再见
formula: const phase = Math.sin(t * 4); return { bones: { rightUpperArm: [0, 0, -2.5 + phase * 0.4], rightLowerArm: [0, 0, -0.3] }, scenePosY: Math.abs(phase) * 0.02 };

name: bow
label: 鞠躬
description: 弯腰鞠躬, 表示感谢或道歉
formula: const p = t < 1 ? t : Math.max(0, 1 - (t - 1) * 0.7); return { bones: { chest: [p * 0.5, 0, 0], neck: [p * 0.3, 0, 0] } };

name: nod
label: 点头
description: 点头示意, 表示同意或肯定
formula: const phase = (t * 2 * Math.PI) % (Math.PI * 2); const amp = Math.sin(phase) * Math.exp(-t * 0.5) * 0.25; return { bones: { neck: [amp, 0, 0], head: [amp * 0.7, 0, 0] } };

name: shake
label: 摇头
description: 摇头示意, 表示否定或婉拒
formula: const phase = Math.sin(t * 6) * Math.exp(-t * 0.4) * 0.4; return { bones: { head: [0, phase, 0], neck: [0, phase * 0.4, 0] } };

name: clap
label: 鼓掌
description: 双手合拢鼓掌
formula: const cycle = (t * 3) % 1; const close = Math.sin(cycle * Math.PI); return { bones: { leftUpperArm: [0, 0, -0.8], rightUpperArm: [0, 0, 0.8], leftLowerArm: [0, 0, 1.4 - close * 0.3], rightLowerArm: [0, 0, -1.4 + close * 0.3] } };

name: cheer
label: 欢呼
description: 举手挥舞欢呼, 通常伴随蹦跳
formula: const bounce = Math.abs(Math.sin(t * 4)); return { bones: { leftUpperArm: [0, 0, -2.5 + Math.sin(t * 4) * 0.2], rightUpperArm: [0, 0, 2.5 + Math.sin(t * 4 + Math.PI) * 0.2] }, scenePosY: bounce * 0.05 };

name: jump
label: 跳跃
description: 原地起跳, 表示兴奋或强调
formula: const normT = Math.min(1, t / 1.2); const height = normT < 0.5 ? normT * 2 : (1 - (normT - 0.5) * 2); const bend = (1 - normT) * 0.6; return { bones: { leftUpperLeg: [-bend, 0, 0], rightUpperLeg: [-bend, 0, 0], leftLowerLeg: [bend * 1.5, 0, 0], rightLowerLeg: [bend * 1.5, 0, 0], leftUpperArm: [0, 0, -2.2 - height * 0.3], rightUpperArm: [0, 0, 2.2 + height * 0.3] }, scenePosY: Math.max(0, height * 0.4) };

name: walk
label: 走路
description: 原地走路姿态, 配合 scene.x 位移可横向移动
formula: const phase = Math.sin(t * 5.2); return { bones: { leftUpperLeg: [phase * 0.45, 0, 0], rightUpperLeg: [-phase * 0.45, 0, 0], leftLowerLeg: [Math.max(0, -phase * 0.4), 0, 0], rightLowerLeg: [Math.max(0, phase * 0.4), 0, 0], leftUpperArm: [-phase * 0.3, 0, 0], rightUpperArm: [phase * 0.3, 0, 0] }, scenePosY: Math.abs(Math.sin(t * 5.2)) * 0.025, scenePosX: Math.sin(t * 5.2 / 2) * 0.06 };

name: run
label: 跑步
description: 原地跑步姿态, 速度更快
formula: const phase = Math.sin(t * 9); return { bones: { leftUpperLeg: [phase * 0.7, 0, 0], rightUpperLeg: [-phase * 0.7, 0, 0], leftLowerLeg: [Math.max(0, -phase * 0.6), 0, 0], rightLowerLeg: [Math.max(0, phase * 0.6), 0, 0], leftUpperArm: [-phase * 0.55, 0, 0], rightUpperArm: [phase * 0.55, 0, 0] }, scenePosY: Math.abs(Math.sin(t * 9)) * 0.05, scenePosX: Math.sin(t * 9 / 2) * 0.1 };

name: dance
label: 跳舞
description: 原版 dance（旧 groove 之前的）
formula: return { bones: { hips: [0, t * 1.2, Math.sin(t * 2) * 0.15], chest: [0, 0, Math.sin(t * 2) * 0.25], leftUpperArm: [0, 0, -2.5 + Math.sin(t * 2.5) * 0.6], rightUpperArm: [0, 0, 2.5 + Math.sin(t * 2.5 + Math.PI) * 0.6] }, scenePosY: Math.abs(Math.sin(t * 4)) * 0.05, scenePosX: Math.sin(t * 2) * 0.04 };

name: sing
label: 唱歌
description: 唱歌姿态, 手放胸前像握话筒
formula: return { bones: { neck: [-0.15 + Math.sin(t * 3) * 0.05, 0, 0], chest: [-0.05, Math.sin(t * 1.5) * 0.15, 0], rightUpperArm: [0, 0, 1.0] }, scenePosY: Math.abs(Math.sin(t * 2.5)) * 0.025 };

name: laugh
label: 大笑
description: 身体笑姿 + 头前倾 (搭配 laugh 表情)
formula: const phase = Math.sin(t * 6) * 0.15; return { bones: { chest: [phase * 0.3, 0, phase * 0.3], head: [-0.05 + Math.abs(phase) * 0.2, 0, phase * 0.2] }, scenePosY: Math.abs(Math.sin(t * 4)) * 0.04 };

name: cry
label: 哭泣
description: 低头哭泣姿态 (搭配 cry 表情)
formula: const breath = Math.sin(t * 2) * 0.05; return { bones: { head: [0.25 + breath, 0, Math.sin(t * 1.3) * 0.08], spine: [0.15, 0, 0] } };

name: think
label: 思考
description: 歪头思考 (右手托下巴)
formula: return { bones: { neck: [0, 0.25 + Math.sin(t * 0.5) * 0.05, 0], rightUpperArm: [0, 0, -1.6], rightLowerArm: [-1.2, 0, 0] }, scenePosY: Math.abs(Math.sin(t * 0.6)) * 0.015 };

name: point
label: 指示
description: 手指某处
formula: return { bones: { rightUpperArm: [0, 0, -1.6], rightLowerArm: [-0.2, 0, 0], neck: [0, -0.1, 0] } };

name: sit
label: 坐下
description: 坐下 (膝盖 90°)
formula: return { bones: { leftUpperLeg: [-1.5, 0, 0], rightUpperLeg: [-1.5, 0, 0] }, scenePosY: -0.35 };

name: sleep
label: 睡觉
description: 睡觉 (低头闭眼)
formula: const breath = Math.sin(t * 0.6) * 0.05; return { bones: { neck: [0.4 + breath, 0, 0], head: [0.6, 0, 0] }, scenePosY: -0.05 };

name: stretch
label: 伸懒腰
description: 伸懒腰 (抬手+头仰)
formula: const phase = t < 2 ? t / 2 : (t < 3.5 ? 1 : Math.max(0, 1 - (t - 3.5) * 2)); return { bones: { leftUpperArm: [0, 0, -2.7 * phase], rightUpperArm: [0, 0, 2.7 * phase], head: [-0.2 * phase, 0, 0] }, scenePosY: Math.sin(t * 2) * 0.02 * phase };

name: greet
label: 行礼
description: 正式行礼 (抬手 + 点头)
formula: const nod = Math.sin(t * Math.PI * 2) * 0.15 * Math.exp(-t * 0.5); return { bones: { head: [nod, 0, 0], neck: [nod * 0.5, 0, 0], rightUpperArm: [0, 0, -2.4], rightLowerArm: [0, 0, -0.3] } };

name: salute
label: 敬礼
description: 敬礼
formula: return { bones: { rightUpperArm: [0, 0, -2.5], rightLowerArm: [0, 0, -0.6], head: [-0.05, 0, 0] } };

name: kiss
label: 飞吻
description: 飞吻
formula: return { bones: { rightUpperArm: [0, 0, -1.8], rightLowerArm: [-0.5, 0, 0], head: [-0.2, 0, 0.2 * Math.sin(t * 8)] } };

name: shrug
label: 摊手
description: 摊手 (我不知道 / 无可奈何)
formula: const normT = Math.min(1, t / 1.5); return { bones: { leftUpperArm: [0, 0, -1.6 * normT], leftUpperArm: [-0.4 * normT, 0, 0], rightUpperArm: [0, 0, 1.6 * normT], rightUpperArm: [-0.4 * normT, 0, 0], head: [0, Math.sin(t * Math.PI) * 0.1 * normT, 0] } };

name: talk
label: 讲话
description: 讲话姿态 (微动+呼吸)
formula: return { bones: { chest: [Math.sin(t * 3) * 0.05, 0, 0] }, scenePosY: Math.abs(Math.sin(t * 3)) * 0.02 };

name: explain
label: 讲解
description: 讲解姿态 (双手前伸比划)
formula: return { bones: { leftUpperArm: [0, 0, -1.0 + Math.sin(t * 1.5) * 0.3], rightUpperArm: [0, 0, 1.0 + Math.sin(t * 1.5 + Math.PI) * 0.3], leftLowerArm: [-0.3, 0, 0], rightLowerArm: [-0.3, 0, 0] }, scenePosY: Math.abs(Math.sin(t * 1.2)) * 0.018 };

name: listen
label: 倾听
description: 安静倾听 (歪头 + 看着对方)
formula: return { bones: { neck: [0, 0.18, 0], head: [Math.sin(t * 0.4) * 0.06 - 0.04, Math.sin(t * 0.6) * 0.1, 0] }, scenePosY: Math.abs(Math.sin(t * 0.7)) * 0.018 };

name: pray
label: 祈祷
description: 双手合十 (感谢 / 求好运)
formula: return { bones: { leftUpperArm: [0, 0, -0.6], rightUpperArm: [0, 0, 0.6], leftLowerArm: [-1.2, 0, 0], rightLowerArm: [-1.2, 0, 0], head: [-0.1, 0, 0] } };

name: groove
label: 节奏律动
description: BPM 驱动的节奏律动（每拍一次弹跳 + 两拍一次左右摆）
formula: const P = Math.PI; const bounce = Math.abs(Math.sin(t * P)); const sway = Math.sin(t * P / 2); const legBend = 0.32 - bounce * 0.22; const hipsY = -legBend * 0.16; const hipsRY = 0.30 * sway; const hipsRZ = 0.06 * Math.sin(t * P); const spineY = -hipsRY * 0.55; const spineZ = -hipsRZ * 0.6; const headZ = 0.10 * Math.sin(t * P + 0.6); const headX = 0.08 * Math.sin(t * 2 * P); const headY = -hipsRY * 0.4; const sw = Math.sin(t * P / 2); return { bones: { hips: [0, hipsRY, hipsRZ], spine: [0, spineY, spineZ], chest: [0, spineY * 0.5, spineZ * 0.5], neck: [headX * 0.4, headY * 0.4, headZ * 0.4], head: [headX, headY, headZ], leftUpperArm: [-0.45 + 0.45 * sw, 0.12, -1.15 + 0.18 * Math.sin(t * P)], rightUpperArm: [-0.45 - 0.45 * sw, -0.12, 1.15 - 0.18 * Math.sin(t * P)], leftLowerArm: [0, 0.9 + 0.3 * sw, -0.2], rightLowerArm: [0, -0.9 + 0.3 * sw, 0.2], leftUpperLeg: [-legBend, 0, 0.03], rightUpperLeg: [-legBend, 0, -0.03], leftLowerLeg: [legBend * 1.9, 0, 0], rightLowerLeg: [legBend * 1.9, 0, 0] }, scenePosY: hipsY };

name: idol
label: 偶像挥手
description: 举臂左右摆动（BPM 驱动）
formula: const P = Math.PI; const wave = Math.sin(t * P / 2); const legBend = 0.12 + 0.10 * Math.abs(Math.sin(t * P)); const hipsY = -legBend * 0.12; const hipsRZ = 0.10 * wave; const hipsRY = 0.12 * Math.sin(t * P / 4); const spineZ = 0.10 * wave; const headZ = 0.16 * wave; const headX = -0.05; return { bones: { hips: [0, hipsRY, hipsRZ], spine: [0, 0, spineZ], chest: [0, 0, spineZ * 0.5], neck: [headX * 0.4, 0, headZ * 0.4], head: [headX, 0, headZ], leftUpperArm: [0.2 * wave, 0, 0.95 - 1.15 * (1 - 0)], rightUpperArm: [-0.2 * wave, 0, -0.95 + 1.15 * (1 - 0)], leftLowerArm: [0, 0, 0.5 + 0.45 * wave], rightLowerArm: [0, 0, -0.5 + 0.45 * wave], leftUpperLeg: [-legBend, 0, 0.03], rightUpperLeg: [-legBend, 0, -0.03], leftLowerLeg: [legBend * 1.9, 0, 0], rightLowerLeg: [legBend * 1.9, 0, 0] }, scenePosY: hipsY };
